title: Concept: MD5 selected by name (java) — review required
description: In java, naming MD5 (getInstances*(s*"MD5") requests a broken digest. Name-selected digests hide inside factory calls, so reviewers must check the string, not just the call. The java-specific remedy is selecting "SHA-256".
applicability: java codebases selecting digests by name; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Same as any MD5 use: forged digests where security is assumed; LOW default severity, raised when the digest guards trust.
